tools.name: emote_pic
tools.description: Maybe attach one random picture from the folder configured for an emotion. The call first rolls the emotion's chance (and its cooldown); when it does not fire, the receipt says skipped with a reason and carries no image. Omit emotion to use the current mood from emote_mood; without a valid mood the call is skipped. Use force to bypass chance and cooldown while testing. When it fires, the receipt carries the image as a [blob ...] line with a log: handle for image-sending tools. Only png, jpg, jpeg, gif and webp up to 5 MB are used.

emotion.description: Which emotion folder to draw from. Omit to use the current mood.

avoid.description: File names not to pick, e.g. the last picture you sent.

force.description: Bypass the chance roll and the cooldown; the other rules still apply. For testing.

summary.zh: 按配置的概率决定这次出不出图;出图时从该表情的文件夹随机挑一张,作为附件交给这次对话。
summary.en: Rolls the configured chance; when it fires, picks a random picture from that emotion folder and attaches it.

tools.name: emote_mood
tools.description: Record the emotion you are in right now, so your next replies know it. Stores only { emotion, setAt }; it sends no image and attaches no blob. The mood expires after the configured minutes. Pass clear: true to clear it instead.

emotion.description: The emotion you are in right now.

clear.description: Clear the current mood instead of setting one.

summary.zh: 记下当前心情,供之后的环境说明参考;不发图,也不产生句柄。
summary.en: Records the current mood for later environment notes; sends no image and produces no handle.

tools.name: emote_popup_test
tools.description: Pop one random picture from the configured emotion folders on the desktop, without sending a chat message. Use when the panel is unavailable or to check the popup.

summary.zh: 不经过面板,直接从表情目录随机弹一张测试图。
summary.en: Pops a random test picture from the emotion folders without the panel.

prompts.title: 情绪配图
prompts.content:
## 情绪配图
{{emotePics.text}}

当前心情:{{emotePics.mood}}。心情标签是你自己上报的当前状态,只作参考;要配图仍然要你自己调 emote_pic。心情和 emotion 参数不一致时,以心情标签为准。不是每条都要配图,有情绪又合适的时候带一张就够了。

心情会从你气泡里的表情标记自动更新(`【开心】`、`<眨眼>` 这类),不用每次手动上报。想在不说话时改心情、或清空,再调 emote_mood。

心情不是配图义务:不传 emotion 调 emote_pic 才会用到心情;照旧是「有情绪、又合适的时候才带图」,不要为了刷新心情而发图。
